intro: Camping 101: Enchanting directs practitioners of the arcane craft to Shen'dar Village to learn how to create specialized wilderness gear. By speaking with Nasalanna Windsinger, proven enchanters can learn to fashion an Enchanted Lute to entertain and bolster their companions around the campfire.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
